name: probes-r1
note: Phase 3 probes (docs/avatar-plan.md v2 §6, 2026-11-09), on the approved bases (female-3, male-2 of bases-r1): outfit-female / outfit-male = the base body WORN with the approved character's clothes (the body-is-the-outfit route: head cut at the socket, skin keyed to a tint layer, no subtraction); hair-sub = head-scale worn-then-subtract (the 1024 head crop of the base, hair added in grey); hair-green = the green-scalp mannequin route (scalp painted #00FF00 in the crop, keyed with the magenta); lids-female = the blink frame. Two candidates each.

outfit-female.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached COW on magenta is one of this game's animals: match its rendering (soft painterly, flat colour with gentle shading, soft thick outlines, no texture). The attached young farm woman on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game, and the attached bald figure in a tan undershift on magenta is that character's BASE BODY, drawn at exactly the same size and position. Redraw the BASE BODY EXACTLY as it is, pixel for pixel: the same bald head, face, eyes, eyebrows, ears, skin tone, the same size and position in the frame, the same arms, hands and bare feet, the same contact shadow, changing NOTHING about it, and dress it ONLY in her clothes: the teal-green laced bodice over the cream long-sleeved blouse, the rust-brown ankle-length skirt, the tan apron, and her brown shoes on the feet (the one place the base changes besides the clothes), exactly as the approved character wears it, following the base body's arms and legs. The head stays bald and clean, no hair, no hat. Everything that is not the garment stays identical to the base body image. The background is a perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere that is not the drawing: no gradient, no texture, no scene, no frame, no text; never pink, never magenta, never purple on the drawing itself.
